claim: Simultaneous prosecution of causes of action alleging breach of contract and anticipatory breach of contract is barred, rendering a proposed amendment to add an anticipatory breach claim patently devoid of merit only where a plaintiff has both elected its remedy by asserting a breach of contract cause of action and formally served the amended complaint on the defendant.
initial_reasoning: NY Slip Op 00995 does not address the bar on simultaneous prosecution of breach of contract and anticipatory breach claims, nor does it establish that an amendment adding an anticipatory breach claim is patently devoid of merit only when the plaintiff has elected a breach remedy and served the amended complaint. The opinion discusses a different procedural issue and does not support the stated claim.
